newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Savage says m.d. Jim Wall to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Savage says m.d. Jim Wall to retire.

text.p: Base metals miner Savage Resources Ltd said on Wednesday its managing director Jim Wall would retire to pursue other interests.

Pending the selection of a new managing director, the current executive general, exploration and development, John Gaskell, would return to Australia from the U.S. as acting chief executive, Savage said.

Savage Zinc America president David Rice would continue in his present role, while Rod Ruston, currently managing director of Wambo Mining Corp Pty Ltd, had been taken on as executive general manager, coal, it said.
Savage said the company grew into its current form as a U.S. zinc producer and copper/gold mine developer at Ernest Henry in Queensland with strategic coal interests under Wall's direction.
Wall, who held the position since 1992, would continue in an advisory capacity until October, the company said.
